description: This file defines the SiloMessagingOptions class within the Orleans.Configuration namespace, which specifies global messaging configuration options related to silos in Orleans. It extends MessagingOptions and includes various properties for configuring messaging behavior like queue sizes, timeouts, request limits, and workload analysis periods.

classes.name: SiloMessagingOptions
classes.description: A class that encapsulates silo-related messaging configuration options, including properties for queues, timeouts, limits, and analysis periods.

methods.name: SystemResponseTimeout
methods.description: Property that gets or sets the timeout for internal system requests, with special handling if a debugger is attached.
